title: 第2章 濒死幻境金手指初现第3章 寿元暴涨痴傻伪装避锋芒
slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
轰然砸落浅水滩的一刻，剧痛瞬间贯穿全身。
浑身骨骼仿佛被重锤生生砸碎、揉烂，再粗暴塞回皮肉之中。
血沫混着浑浊泥水，疯狂从口鼻翻涌溢出。陈默的手指在湿冷淤泥里痉挛抽搐，指尖死死抠进泥层，却浑身脱力，连抬起一寸手臂的力气都榨不出来。
崖顶浓雾沉沉遮蔽一切，听不见人声，望不见天际。
断龙崖上的冷眼、算计、驱逐，尽数被山风隔绝。短短数息，世间仿佛彻底抹去了他的存在。
伤势早已濒临致命。
至少三根肋骨断裂，骨刺刺穿肺腑，每一次呼吸都牵扯撕裂剧痛，胸腔里满是血腥的破风声。左腿骨骼错位扭曲，脚踝皮肉崩裂翻卷，青紫肿胀可怖。后脑撞击造成的骨裂凹陷，温热的血水浸透半边白发，黏腻腥冷。
他的意识摇摇欲坠，像风中残烛，明灭不定，随时都会彻底熄灭。
要死了。
二十年苟活，命格残缺，经脉废碎，修行三年寸功未立，是全宗门人人可欺的废物。
同门鄙夷践踏，所谓同门照拂，不过柳如烟随手施舍的废丹残渣。
屈辱、冷眼、磋磨，熬了整整三年，最终落得被同门构陷、被师尊舍弃、推落万丈深渊的结局。
可即便如此，他心底只剩一个执念——
他不想死。
无关复仇，无关证明。绝境求生，是刻在骨血里的本能，如荒草碾入泥土，根不死，便不肯寂灭。
心跳越来越微弱，沉重迟缓，几近停滞。
视野彻底沉入漆黑，耳畔只剩血脉轰鸣的死寂。
濒死之际，诡异异变陡生。
他的神识骤然离体，轻飘飘悬浮在躯体之上，冷静、漠然，毫无波澜地俯视着滩涂上残破的自己。
泥血糊满脸庞，衣衫碎裂不堪，那双标志性的琥珀色异瞳彻底黯淡。

一具破败不堪、任人丢弃的残躯。
无人惋惜，无人收尸，死得轻如蝼蚁。
没有愤怒，没有不甘，只剩旁观者般的冰冷淡漠。
就在这时，一尺高的金色沙漏，凭空悬于他躯体正上方。
细密的金沙静静流淌，簌簌轻响，清晰可闻。
生死倒计时，已然开启。
最后一粒金沙坠落的瞬间，沙漏轰然震颤，刺目金光炸裂开来。
content_en:
The moment it crashed into the shallow water, severe pain instantly shot through the body.
All the bones in the body seemed to have been smashed and crushed by heavy hammers, and then roughly stuffed back into the flesh.
Blood foam mixed with muddy water, crazily gushing out from the mouth and nose. Chen Mo's fingers twitched in the wet and cold mud. His fingertips dug into the mud, but he was so exhausted that he couldn't even lift his arm an inch.
The thick fog on the top of the cliff obscured everything, making it impossible to hear people's voices and unable to see the sky.
The cold looks, calculations, and expulsions on Broken Dragon Cliff were all isolated by the mountain wind. In just a few breaths, his existence seemed to have been completely wiped out from the world.
The injuries were already on the verge of fatality.
At least three ribs were broken, and bone spurs pierced his lungs. Every breath he took caused severe tearing pain, and his chest was filled with the bloody sound of breaking wind. The bones of his left leg were misaligned and twisted, the skin and flesh of his ankle were cracked and rolled, and he was horribly bruised and swollen. The bone cracks and depressions caused by the impact on the back of the head, warm blood soaked through half of the white hair, making it sticky and cold.
His consciousness was shaky, like a candle in the wind, flickering and extinguished at any moment.
Dying.
After twenty years of surviving, his fate is incomplete, his meridians are broken, and he has practiced for three years without making any achievements. He is a waste that can be bullied by everyone in the entire sect.
The fellow disciples despised and trampled upon him, and the so-called fellow disciples looked after him, but they were nothing more than the remains of useless elixirs that Liu Ruyan gave away casually.
After three full years of humiliation, cold looks, and grinding, he finally ended up being framed by his fellow disciples, abandoned by his master, and pushed into the abyss.
But even so, there was only one obsession left in his heart——
He doesn't want to die.
It’s not about revenge, it’s not about proof. Survival in desperate situations is an instinct engraved in the bones and blood. It is like a weed that grinds into the soil and refuses to die until its roots die.
The heartbeat became weaker and weaker, heavy and slow, almost stagnant.
His vision completely disappeared into darkness, and only the dead silence of the roar of blood was left in his ears.
On the verge of death, strange changes occurred suddenly.
His consciousness suddenly left his body and floated lightly above his body. He looked down at his broken body on the beach calmly and indifferently without any waves.
His face was covered with mud and blood, his clothes were torn to pieces, and his iconic amber eyes were completely dim.
A dilapidated body left to be discarded.
No one felt sorry for him, no one collected his body, and his death was as light as an ant.
There was no anger, no unwillingness, just the cold indifference of a bystander.
At this moment, a one-foot-tall golden hourglass hung directly above his body out of thin air.
The fine golden sand flows quietly, and the rustling sound is clearly audible.
The countdown to life and death has begun.
The moment the last grain of golden sand fell, the hourglass trembled violently, and dazzling golden light exploded.
